slides.title: Under £30,000 profit? MTD may still apply
slides.sub: The April 2027 test uses your total sales, not your profit.

slides.title: £30,000 from 6 April 2027
body: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax widens next April.
It applies if your qualifying income was over £30,000.
HMRC looks at your 2025/26 tax return.

slides.title: It's total sales, not profit
body: Qualifying income is self-employment and property income.
It is the amount before expenses.
Your wages from a job do not count.

slides.title: Worked example
slides.result: Over £30,000, so MTD applies from 6 April 2027.
slides.note: Self-employed only, no property income, 2025/26 figures.

slides.title: Next step down: £20,000
body: From 6 April 2028 the line drops to £20,000.
